        - '\cmd.exe'

        - '\pwsh.exe'
        - '\winrs.exe'
        - '\wmic.exe'
        - '\net.exe'

        - '\reg.exe'
filter1:
    TargetServerName: 'localhost'
filter2:
    SubjectUserName|endswith: '$'
    TargetUserName|endswith: '$'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter*
versions.spl: EventID=4648 ProcessName IN ("*\\cmd.exe", "*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe", "*\\winrs.exe", "*\\wmic.exe", "*\\net.exe", "*\\net1.exe", "*\\reg.exe") NOT (TargetServerName="localhost" OR (SubjectUserName="*$" TargetUserName="*$"))
